title: Mapping Christchurch earthquake shaking, March 2011
credit: NASA Earth Observatory, Robert Simmon; EO-1 ALI data and USGS Earthquake Hazard Program; legend adapted by Wikimedia contributor Avenue
altText: Aerial view of Christchurch overlaid with coloured circles indicating 2011 earthquake ground shaking intensity and a colour key.
caption: Satellite view of Christchurch on 4 March 2011, annotated with earthquake shaking measurements and a colour key following the 22 February 2011 earthquake.
context: Retrospective analytical earthquake map. It does not depict the live emergency management common operating picture.
sourceFileTitle: File:Christchurch from space, 4 March 2011, showing quake shaking strength, with key.png
